<Aside type="caution" title="Dated phase-status snapshot — paths have since moved">
This is a historical implementation-status record (Phase 1–§MHS work,
through mid-2026). It's preserved as a dated milestone log; **the file paths
and a few component names below are stale** after later refactors. The big
renames to keep in mind when reading:

- `apps/papercup/**` and `apps/papercusp/**` → the operator now lives at
  **`apps/operator/`**; its Next.js `app/api/**` routes were ported to **Hono
  routers under `packages/operator-core/lib/endpoint-route/routes/**`**.
- The operator-side process-level lifecycle host moved to
  **`packages/operator-core/lib/plugin-host-runtime.ts`**. The React-render
  layer named below (`lib/plugin-runtime.ts`, `lib/PluginTabs.tsx`,
  `lib/PluginReactTab.tsx`) did **not** move — it still lives under
  **`apps/operator/lib/`**.
- The `run.sh` → TS orchestrator port shipped and its ported run-loop was
  later **retired** (see [orchestrator-port](/internal/docs/implementation/orchestrator-port));
  the live pipeline is the DBOS runner in `packages/operator-core/lib/dbos/`.
- The `papercuspai.com` marketplace described in the "After all of the above"
  table was superseded by the in-app **Cupboard** (`apps/operator-public`).
</Aside>

The reference runtime lives in this monorepo (`Papercusp/papercup`). Phase numbering matches the spec sections; some phases were split into a/b for separable shipping.

## What's gating v1.0

All 5 of the 6b sub-tasks have landed:

1. ✅ Lifecycle hooks — `beforeMissionStart` / `onLoad` / `onFeaturePassed` / `onProposalAccepted` fire from the operator (Hono routes); `beforeMissionStart` / `afterDone` / `onPostOrchestrator` / `onPostValidator` fire from `run.sh` via the `papercusp-fire-hook` CLI.
2. ✅ Mount plugin `apiRoutes` — `mountPluginApiRoutes` runs at `/api/[[...route]]/route.ts` startup.
3. ✅ Typed-service DI container — `createPapercuspApi` in `@papercusp/plugin-loader/api-factory.ts`.
4. ✅ Construct gated `PapercuspContext` — `buildPapercuspContext` + per-(plugin, harness) `ServerActionRegistry` attached as `ctx.actions`. Plugins like `@papercupai/cloudflare-pages` that `ctx.actions.register('publish', handler)` from `init()` now succeed.
5. ✅ `componentId` → lazy React registry — `lib/plugin-runtime.ts` resolver, `lib/PluginTabs.tsx` strip, `lib/PluginReactTab.tsx` single-tab render. Wired into `HarnessDashboard.tsx` (the dashboard's tab strip includes React-mode plugin tabs alongside iframe ones).

Residual cleanups (none gate v1.0):

- v2 iframe-CSP loader (deferred per spec §8.6).

### After 6b (plugin architecture)

| Item | Scope | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| ~~Plugin schema auto-apply at install~~ | ✅ Already wired + types unified 2026-04-29 | The branch in `papercusp install` (libs/papercusp/packages/cli/src/papercusp.ts) already runs DDL via `psql ON_ERROR_STOP=1` when `manifest.schema` is set. The SDK type was `PluginSchemaDef = {schemaName, ddlPath}` while the install code expected `string[]`. Unified: SDK now exports `PluginSchemaField = PluginSchemaDef \| PluginSchemaDef[] \| string[]`; install normalizes via a new `normalizeSchemaField` helper. 6 unit tests cover all three shapes + malformed input. No existing plugin uses the field yet, but the type/runtime mismatch is gone and the path is exercisable. |
| ~~Marketplace → auto-install drop-in~~ | ✅ Already wired + cache-busting added 2026-04-29 | The UI flow already existed end-to-end: `<InstallPluginButton>` (in `MarketplaceList.tsx`) POSTs to `/api/marketplace/install-plugin`, which shells out to `papercusp install <slug> --accept-capabilities`. The CLI extracts the tarball into `~/.papercusp/global-plugins/<name>/` and (post-2026-04-29) auto-applies any `manifest.schema` DDL via psql. **What was missing:** the in-process runtime cache (`globalThis`-pinned for HMR robustness) didn't know about the just-installed plugin. Now both the install and uninstall endpoints call `_resetPluginHostForTests()` + `_resetPluginApiRoutesForTests()` after a successful CLI run, so the next request re-discovers and the new plugin's `init` / `onLoad` fire on first slug contact. Verified end-to-end against `@papercupai/docs-viewer`: `initializedPairs` goes from 6 → 0 after the install POST. |
| ~~Plugin hot-reload in dev mode~~ | ✅ Shipped 2026-04-29 | `watchPluginsForReload({dir})` in `lib/plugin-host-runtime.ts` — opt-in via `PAPERCUSP_DEV_PLUGIN_WATCH=1` env var. Recursive `fs.watch` on `~/.papercusp/global-plugins/` with a 250ms debounce; only resets on `papercusp.json` / `index.{js,mjs,ts}` / `dist/index.js` changes (ignores editor swap files + `node_modules` churn). Watcher handle pinned on `globalThis` so HMR doesn't double-arm it. Production hosts leave it off. |
| ~~Wildcard `secrets:read:PREFIX_*` capability~~ | ✅ Shipped 2026-04-29 | Both flavors land together: subdomain (`http:fetch:*.foo.com`) and prefix (`secrets:read:YT_*`). Implemented in `hasCapability` via a shared `matchWildcardCap` helper — also reused by `actions.ts` for action-cap subset validation. Strict semantics: `*.foo.com` does NOT match the bare suffix `foo.com`; `head*` requires a non-empty head and a non-empty tail (degenerate `secrets:read:*` is rejected). 5 new tests in `capabilities.test.ts`. |
| ~~`compute:exec:<binary>` capability~~ | ✅ Shipped 2026-04-29 | Added `compute:exec:<basename>` to the SDK Capability union; existing wildcard helper handles `compute:exec:py-*` style prefix grants. New `PapercuspContext.spawn?: PluginSpawn` typed surface — async returns `{stdout, stderr, code, killed}`. Host implementation in `lib/plugin-host-runtime.ts` (`makePluginSpawn`): rejects path-bearing bins (basename only), gates on `compute:exec:<basename>`, ensures the plugin's data dir exists before spawn, captures stdout/stderr to 1 MiB each (truncated marker on overflow), 30 s timeout with SIGTERM→SIGKILL escalation. Verified end-to-end against a probe plugin: declared `compute:exec:echo` succeeds with `code=0 stdout="hello-from-spawn"`; undeclared `ls` rejects with MissingCapability; `/bin/echo` rejects before cap check on the path-separator guard. |
| ~~Plugin runtime versioning + CHANGELOG~~ | ✅ Shipped 2026-04-29 | `PAPERCUSP_RUNTIME_VERSION = '0.1.0'` constant in the SDK; loader rejects plugins whose `papercusp:` range excludes the runtime version. Minimal in-tree semver matcher in `packages/plugin-loader/src/semver.ts` covers `X.Y.Z` / `^X.Y.Z` (incl. caret-leading-zero) / `~X.Y.Z` / `>=X.Y.Z` / `*`. 9 semver tests + 1 negative-path loader test. CHANGELOG authored at `packages/plugin-sdk/CHANGELOG.md` — covers the lifecycle hooks, free-form bus, action registry, capability strings (incl. wildcards), manifest schema, loader contract, host runtime APIs, and the recent shape changes. |
| ~~Reference plugins (slack-notify, jira-sync)~~ | ✅ Already authored — symlinks repointed 2026-04-29 | Both `@papercupai/slack-notifier` (1 action: `notify`) and `@papercupai/jira-sync` (3 actions: `create-issue`, `list-issues`, `post-comment`) lived at `papercupai-workspace/papercusp/plugins/` but their global-plugins symlinks still pointed at a retired location in a separate internal project (`…/libs/papercusp/plugins/`), so the runtime was silently skipping them. Repointed; both load cleanly, register all their declared actions, and the slack `notify` invoke probe returns the expected "SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL not configured" envelope. |
